'''Savo''' was a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] hired to protect [[Shalo Sherin]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] had a close relationship with her fellow bodyguard, [[Camerlin]]. In combat, she preferred to use a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].<ref name="LoNH" />
